title: Checkout App: Branding
description: Split proposal C: mixed (HRP-727). Holds a sub-object per touchpoint: pos, sco, mpos, customerDisplay. Prototype: not registered in CCC, so it renders but cannot be saved. Proposed IAM role: checkout-branding-editor.
